newsitem.title: USA: Vivid gets FAA order for detection systems.
newsitem.headline: Vivid gets FAA order for detection systems.

text.p: Vivid Technologies Inc said Monday that the Federal Aviation Administration placed an order for the company's automated dual energy X-ray explosives detection systems.

The initial purchase is for eight Vivid systems representing a total value of $4 million with an option to acquire 12 additional systems which would bring the total maximum contract value to $10.7 million, a news release issued by Vivid said.

The purchase of Vivid's systems was a result of a congressional directive contained in the Federal Aviation Reauthorization Act of 1996 to deploy a variety of commercially available explosives detection devices to enhance aviation security.
The systems are scheduled to be shipped in Vivid's fiscal 1998 and deployed at several of the nation's largest and busiest airports.
